item.title: HSBC SVNS: New Zealand march on in Vancouver with fourth win in five tournaments
item.description: The Black Ferns Sevens have never lost a match at Vancouver’s BC Place

item.title: New Zealand and South Africa top of the HSBC SVNS world in Vancouver
item.description: Black Ferns Sevens maintain their long unbeaten record at BC Place, while Blitzboks laid down a marker ahead of the final event of the regular HSBC SVNS Series in New York.

item.title: Draw throws up more blockbuster match-ups as HSBC SVNS heads to New York
item.description: Big games and bigger upsets in store on the final stop on the HSBC SVNS Series before the three-tournament World Championships

item.title: Teams in a grubber kick state of mind as HSBC SVNS heads to New York
item.description: The HSBC SVNS in Vancouver was an explosive blur of high-impact rugby, but — writes former sevens star Luke Treharne — beneath the spectacle at BC Place, we saw the beginnings of a subtle tactical trend in sevens rugby.

item.title: Less is more: the reality of prepping for back-to-back HSBC SVNS tournaments
item.description: As New York takes HSBC SVNS centre stage a week after Vancouver, former international sevens star Tom Mitchell explains how players get ready for the second weekend of back-to-back tournaments

item.title: Visser brings pride to 50th SVNS tournament milestone
item.description: When South Africa’s Blitzboks take the field in New York this weekend on the HSBC SVNS Series, captain Impi Visser will reach a landmark few players in the demanding world of rugby sevens manage: his 50th tournament on the global circuit.

item.title: Youthful Argentina ‘getting closer’, warns men’s head coach Gómez Cora
item.description: A young Los Pumas squad is eying up the World Championships as the time to shine, writes Luke Norman

item.title: Tight at the top as HSBC SVNS arrives in New York for the first time
item.description: The slimmest of margins separates Fiji and South Africa at the top of the men’s table, while New Zealand and Australia will fight it out at the top of the women’s competition in the final round of the main HSBC SVNS Series in New York.

item.title: True professional Abbie Brown takes the tough route
item.description: Great Britain veteran on her return to HSBC SVNS action after an injury lay-off, her Olympic ambitions, and what it means to play for her country
